The Hyrule Compendium has 509 entries in total, divided into five major categories: Creatures, Monsters, Materials, Equipment, and Treasure. Many people only discover late in the game that they're missing dozens of photos, without knowing which category they're missing from. This article explains the unlocking process, the gap-checking method, and the replacement-purchase rules, so collecting can proceed step by step without relying on luck.

常见问题
FAQ
相机与图鉴不是开局就有的，要经主线“给地底人拍照”解锁：去监视堡垒南边的深穴，跟着洛贝利走完流程，普尔亚帕德就会获得相机功能，图鉴也随之开启。解锁越早越好，之后遇到的每种生物和怪物顺手拍一张，后期就不用专门回头补。

The camera and Compendium aren't available from the start — they unlock through the main quest “Camera Work in the Depths”: go to the chasm south of Lookout Landing, follow Robbie through the process, and the Purah Pad will gain the camera function, with the Compendium opening along with it. The earlier you unlock them, the better — afterwards, snap a photo of each new creature and monster you meet, and you won't need to specially go back to fill gaps later.
图鉴共 509 项，分五类：生物、怪物、材料、装备、宝物。查漏时按类查，不要按地点瞎找：先看哪一类缺得多，再针对性地去那类出没的区域。装备类很多来自宝箱和商店，宝物类则与呀哈哈、地底宝箱等收集要素相关，缺漏往往集中在这两类。

The Compendium has 509 entries in five categories: Creatures, Monsters, Materials, Equipment, and Treasure. When checking for gaps, check by category, not by blindly searching by location: first see which category is missing the most, then go specifically to the areas where that category appears. Many Equipment entries come from treasure chests and shops, while Treasure entries relate to collecting elements like Koroks and Depths chests — gaps are often concentrated in these two categories.
用相机拍摄海拉鲁生物
Photographing Hyrule creatures with the camera
拍照登录：对准目标拍下即算一条（游戏实机截图）
Photo registration: aiming at the target and taking the photo counts as one entry (in-game screenshot)
拍照登录的判定很宽松：对准目标、拍清楚就能登录，不用拍得多艺术。怪物拍照时注意安全，远距离用相机变焦拍也可以登录，不用贴脸。同一目标拍多次只算一条，换目标才有新条目。养成习惯：新区域先拍一圈，Boss 战前先拍 Boss，错过一次可能要等血月刷新。

Photo registration is judged leniently: aim at the target and take a clear photo to register — it doesn't need to be artistic. When photographing monsters, mind your safety: photographing from far away with the camera zoom also registers, with no need to get up close. Photographing the same target multiple times only counts as one entry; only a new target gives a new entry. Build the habit: photograph a full round in each new area, and photograph a boss before the boss fight — missing once may mean waiting for a Blood Moon refresh.
缺漏照片不用满地图重找：去哈特诺古代研究所找洛贝利，按类别购买。普通照片 100 卢比一张，类别内随机给，买之前先确认缺的是哪一类，别跨类乱买。通关后精英敌人照片涨到 500 卢比一张，精英怪的照片建议通关前尽量自己拍，省钱又省事。

You don't need to search the whole map again for missing photos: go to Robbie at the Hateno Ancient Tech Lab and buy by category. Ordinary photos cost 100 Rupees each, given randomly within the category — confirm which category you're missing before buying, and don't buy randomly across categories. After clearing the game, elite enemy photos rise to 500 Rupees each, so it's recommended to photograph elite monsters yourself before clearing the game as much as possible, saving both money and trouble.
509 项全收集后，奖励是洛贝利的布料，可以用来换滑翔伞外观。图鉴感应器（Sensor+）是另一个相关任务：要求先登录 5 个怪物条目，完成后感应器可以帮你定位图鉴目标，查漏效率会高很多。建议先做感应器任务，再系统性补图鉴。

After collecting all 509 entries, the reward is Robbie's Fabric, which can be used to change the Paraglider's appearance. The Compendium Sensor (Sensor+) is another related quest: it requires registering 5 monster entries first, and once completed, the Sensor can help you locate Compendium targets, greatly improving gap-checking efficiency. It's recommended to do the Sensor quest first, then systematically complete the Compendium.
